name: ExamTimetableClashChecker
tagline: Find every exam clash, capacity breach and extra-time overrun before the timetable goes out.
description: Exam series workspace for schools, colleges and universities: candidate clashes, heavy days, room capacity, access-arrangement overruns and invigilator shortfalls, with drag-to-move, best alternative sessions, clash resolutions and invigilator assignment. Works in Power Pages, Canvas and Model-driven apps.
features: Timetable grid with drag and drop and best alternative sessions
Extra time and rest-break overruns into the next paper
Invigilator ratio, 1:1 readers/scribes, double-booking and availability
Resolutions log, undo and CSV export
Candidate personal timetables, rooms and invigilation views
Phone layout, keyboard and screen-reader support
Privacy mode and read-only portal view
